Name: Bilhan, Son of Jediael
Summary: Son of Jediael and father of Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tharshish, and Ahishahar.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:10: Son of Jediael and father of Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tharshish, and Ahishahar.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Bilhan stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
